chapters: Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu jodai' jix gɨ'kora' dɨr gu India bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' bhaan chamaam gu ñi'ook kɨɨv oidha' gɨ'.
Na mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't gu Susaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu vaik oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' bɨx chiñia' tu duukam da'p vupui bhaan gu kavɨk gu Persia gu Media gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' chiñia' oidha' gɨ'.
Na ba' na ba' gu takarui' namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt gɨ'x bhai' gu suudai' gu ux mui'x gu tanoolh chamaam jix bhai'x gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh naadat u'uu pai' gu ñi'ook vaak ja'tkam bɨx gu ja'tkam dɨr jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm jix ali' gu ñi'ook gu Susaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' ka't jix toja gu vaas gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tasi' ñakaabma' gu suudai' jix toja jodai gu vaak gu duukam; gio ba' gu chuukug jix uam jodai jix toja jodai bhaan gu jodai' gu duukam gu i'ii'ñ jodai na jix tuk.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' i'i gu ux jix uam jodai gu ux gu oi'ñga'n jix jai' suudai' u'va vaak ja'tkam jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' ka't bhaan dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga; na soo'mchulhdhak gu suudai'; na gu' ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak; na gu jodai' bhaan aagak maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu Basti gu takarui' gu u'vɨ gu vaak vaak ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh kua' gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' jix bhai'x suudai' u'va jix aa'ñdhix gu takarui' gu Bista gu arbona gu Bigta gu Abagta gu Setar gu Karkas kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai'.
Na jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' gu Basti vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx kuruun jix suudai' duu na ba' gu takarui' gu ja'tkam chiñia' gu jodai'; na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu suudai' gu Basti cham gu oi'ñga'n jugi gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bhaam gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt jix jai' gu tai gu vaak.
Na gu' tɨtda:―¿Jax jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' mamatdagɨm jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook na gu' ka't gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx bɨx jix bhai'x ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' mi'p ju'ñdharan gu Karsena gu Setar gu Admata gu Tarsis gu Meres gu Marsena gu Memukaan kɨɨv chiñia' gu Persia gu Media jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' dharka' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba'.
Na gu' gu Kuee ka't duñia' bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga bɨɨx gu suudai' gu Basti na gu' cham ka't jix duñia' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' gu Memukaan vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' chiñia'; gio ba' cham gu suudai' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' tu' uañi'ñ gu suudai' gu Basti gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx chiñia' bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam cham tu'x jai'ch bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai'.

Na gu' na gu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu u'vɨ na ba' jix duñia' mambhɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' bɨpna' bham; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' jix aa'ñdhix gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu suudai' gu Basti cham suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu chuukug dhi' gu Jawatan gu Persia gu Media gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bɨx chiñia' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix jai' gu vaak gu duukam.

Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook vaak ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Persia gu Media cham ka't bhaan; na cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Basti vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu gɨ'kora' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu maa'nkar ka't tutkɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' ka't naak bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ux jix gɨ' bɨx gu u'vɨ jix duñia' nɨidhat bɨpna' dɨr jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm jix ali'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu bhóogɨt dhi' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Memukaan.

Na gu' bhañ gu bhóogɨt bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' oidha' gɨ' jurtu'nka' gu o'o gu ja'tkam jurtu'nka' gu suudai' bham bɨx gu chio'ñ jum duu gu Jawatan gu vaak; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt dhi' bhaan nɨɨn gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oi'ñga'n dhi' tu'x gu bhóogɨt tu' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' tɨ'ñcho gu Basti ka't gu takarui' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' jix bhai' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt bɨx oidha' gɨ' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu chuukug bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' jix bhai' gu suudai' gu Susaan gu suudai' jix suudai' duu gu vaak gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu egai gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' jix nukadham gu u'vɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Basti; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' jix duu.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Susaan gu suudai' jix suudai' duu gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu mar gu Jair gu mar gu Simi gu mar gu Kis gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' jix duu ka't jix duñia' bhaan gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu chuukug jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jekôniias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bhaan gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.

Na gu' ka't jix duñia' gu adassa gu Ester mar u'vɨ gu suudai' na gu' cham ga'ra' gu taat tu' gu naan; gio ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' duñia' jix bhai' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu taat gu naan jix koko' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't jix bhɨɨ gu ux mar u'vɨ gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' gu Sukedioo na ja'p jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt mumua'da' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Susaan gu suudai' jix suudai' duu gu chuukug gu egai ka't jix bhɨɨ gio gu Ester na ba' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu egai jix nukadham gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu vupui gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu jix maa jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gio kɨɨv gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨɨx gu takarui' tutkɨ gu vaak gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Ester cham gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't jix aa'ñdhix cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' vupui bhaan naadat gu vaak gu u'vɨ gu ux maachim gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Ester gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.

Na gu' na ja'p jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' jix ai gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu suudai' dhi' tu' gu kutun masaa'n jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ na gu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug dhi' gu ux masaa'n bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ux masaa'n bɨɨx tu'x gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx chɨtda jix duñia' na ba' jix ai bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu u'vɨ bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu xumai gu xibh gu ñi'ook gu vaak gookim gu u'vɨ gu chuukug gu Saasgas gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' jix nukadham gu u'vɨ; gio ba' cham gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't mɨmɨim gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu Ester mar u'vɨ gu Abiail gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't jix bhɨɨ gu ux mar u'vɨ na ba' jix ai gu gɨ'kora' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu egai gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' jix nukadham gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Ester nɨidhidha' bɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu vaak vaak ja'tkam gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Tebet oi'ñga' kɨɨv gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Ester bhaan bɨx gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' jix dhaas kuruun vaak ja'tkam mo'o jix duu gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Basti.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' bɨx chiñia' tu duukam gu takarui' gu Ester; gio ba' jix duñia' oidha' gɨ' jix duu jix maa gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu jodai' gookim jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Ester bhaan ga'ra' jix aa'ñdhix gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham ka't jix duñia' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ja'tkam; na pai' dhuuk na gu' gu Ester jix duñia' chɨtda gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ja'p na pai' dhuuk bɨɨx jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh kua' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim daakat ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Bigtaan gu Teres gook gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' nukadham ki'ñgob jix duñia' gu takarui' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n ka't dhi' gu ux gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Ester gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't bakia' dhuu; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' ba'k jix bɨɨx duu gu jodai' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr ua'na gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ u'uan tu'x gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu Amaan gu mar gu Amadata gu Agageo jix duñia' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx chiñia' mi'p bɨɨx.
Na gu' bɨx tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' mi'p ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Amaan na gu' ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' jix duñia' tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' mi'p ki'ñgob gui'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu tanoolh dhi' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Amaan gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' tu' ka't jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Amaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan; gio ba' jix bhuup gu vaak.

Gu' gu' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ gu duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; na tu' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham tu' duu bɨx tɨtda:―¿Aapi' ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' maa'n gu takarui' gu Nisaan oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' ka't mi'x juu'ñ gu Pur dhi' gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan gu Amaan gu tanoolh gu takarui'; gio ba' jix buus gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Adar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Amaan gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai'; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu kutun tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bɨx oidha' gɨ' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ja'tkam cham gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' cham jupaabkamu'n gu vaak mi'x dhaas.

Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ka't gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' jix duu mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix toja jodai gu noobh gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ na ba' ka't gu suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu novɨ jix maa gu Amaan gu mar gu Amadata gu Agageo bhaamki'ñdha' tɨtda:―¿Aapi'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix toja jodai gu suudai' ka't na ba' tu' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu mɨmɨim gu o'o gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' maa'n gu suudai' ka't ua'nak jurtu'nka' bɨx jix aa'ñdhix gu Amaan chiñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook mi'p bhaan oidha' gɨ' chiñia' gu ja'tkam oidha' gɨ' bhaan gu'p gu ja'tkam bhaan nɨɨn; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' ka't ua'nak gu takarui' bɨɨx gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu novɨ jix duñia' bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' na ba' cham tu' duu kooda' gu chuukug bɨx tɨtda:―¿Aapi' dɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jix bhai'x a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu tanoolh gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Adar na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu vaak ua'nak koi gu ux gu ñi'ook oidha' gɨ' ka't gu takarui' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu suudai' na ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' moor jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ux jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ka't jix maa gu Susaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Amaan mi'p gu bhóogɨt i'i kiicham gu Susaan ka't gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gu ux maatai ka't gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham jiiñkɨk bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' cham ka't jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx tɨi'chu' gu ux.
Jano' ba' oidha' gɨ' pai' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu duukam jix duñia' ko'kmarak tɨtda:―¿Aapi' jix gɨ' gu chuukug gu maa'nkar suanda' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ux maatai ka't gu takarui' mui'x.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu takarui' gu Ester gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu vaak bhañ jajannulhi'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook kutun gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ux bhaan; gu' cham jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Ester jup tɨɨt gu Atak maa'n gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook gu jodai' vupui bhaan jix aa'ñdhix gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx gu vaak maachim gu ñi'ook ka't mii' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu Atak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ɨrban kiicham ka't vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook bɨx ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix maa gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai gu Amaan ka't tu ñi'ook jix duu na ba' gu jodai' na jix uam gu gɨ'kora' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n tɨtda:―¿Aapi' na ba' cham tu' duu.

Jano' ba' jix maa gio gu vaak gu'p gu duukam ka't jix duñia' jix maa gu Susaan na ba' bhaai'n gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu Ester gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jum duu gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu ux gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Atak jix duñia' gu Ester gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Ester gu Atak jix aa'ñdhix a'ga gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' bɨx tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ ba'k gu gɨ'kora' naadat gu ñi'ook cham gu suudai' tɨɨgim gu ux gu duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' koi; gio ba' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu i'ii'ñ jix uam jodai ii'mdagaram; mi' dhɨr tu' cham jix duñia' mɨmɨim na ba' baakɨi gu gɨ'kora' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Ester.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook gu jodai'; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx tɨtda:―¿Aapi'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' jix bhai'x gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu jodai' jix duñia' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' baasɨ'n; gu' tu' gu vaak gu taat jix koi; mi' dhɨr chɨkka gu maa'nkar tu' na ba' dhi' gu tas tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Ester tu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' tu' gu kutun bɨx tɨtda:―¿Aapi' bakia' gu Susaan jix duñia' gu ux tu' cham jugi tu' gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh gu tukaa' tu' gu tanoolh; gio ba' tu' gio bɨɨx gu takarui' gu chuukug gu takarui' ba'k gu gɨ'kora' gu ux cham ka't jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jurtu'nka' bɨx jix aa'ñdhix gu Ester.

Jano' ba' ka't vaik gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu Ester tɨi'chu' vaak ja'tkam jix dhaas naadat gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' daakat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix suudai' duu gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix ñi' gu suudai' gu Ester ka't naadat gu bhóogɨt nɨidhidha' gu vupui; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Ester gu i'ii'ñ jix uam jodai ga'ra' gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Ester gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Kuee gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Ester gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' maa'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Ester; gio ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu Amaan gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug jup tɨɨt gu Amaan na ba' duñia' gu Ester tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu Amaan gu takarui' gu Ester gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ester gu takarui' suudai' u'va; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ tu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ux ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' tu' ka't gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Ester; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu Amaan gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu xibh gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix aa'ñdhix.

Jano' ba' jix buus gu Amaan mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu jodai' jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ; gu' na ja'p jix ñi' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' cham jix búup tu' oidha' bhaan jiim pai' jix bhuup bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' jix duñia' gu Amaan suudai' u'va gu vaak bhañ jix ai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Seres gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Amaan gɇ'kamtu'nda' namkɨm gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam bɨx tu'x bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu suudai' bɨɨx ka't gu oi'ñga'n bhaan chiñia' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Amaan; gio ba' gio gu suudai' gu Ester gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu jix ai bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' na ba' gu xibh jix duñia' amuub bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'.
Gu' gu' bɨx dhi' cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim daakat ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Seres gu u'vɨ bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' xoi'kam gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu xibh tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr ba'k bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' jix bhai'x; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui gu Amaan jix duu gu jodai' gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' ka't koox gu gɨ'kora' jix bhɨɨ u'uan gu i'ii'ñ tu'x gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ua'nak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't gu jodai' gu Bigtan gu Teres gook gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' jix nukadham ki'ñgob gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook nɨidhat gu tasi' jix duu gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ux dhi' tu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr cham tu' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' chɨkka naadat gu Amaan ka't tɨbiap naadat gu tasi' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' na ba' a'ga gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu takarui' ga'ra' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Amaan naadat; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu Amaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chio'ñ nɨidhat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' jix aa' gu Amaan gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr chɨkka jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook nɨidhat gu oi'ñga'n tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Amaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ nɨidhat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨi'chu' vaak ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' kavaayo gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' kuruun vaak ja'tkam jix duñia' mo'o.

Jano' ba' jix maa tɨi'chu' kavaayo gu novɨ oi'ñdha' chiñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' ñiata mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ nɨidhat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' kavaayo gu ux ɨrban kiicham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ nɨidhat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Amaan; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug jix bhɨɨ tɨi'chu' kavaayo na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook tu jiim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr cham gu oi'ñga'n cham tu' bɨx tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Amaan jix bhɨɨ tɨi'chu' kavaayo jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' kavaayo gu ux ɨrban kiicham gu suudai' vupui bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ nɨidhat gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' gu Amaan ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu ñi'ook iiñat mo'o.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Amaan gu Seres gu u'vɨ bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx ka't gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gui'p mamatdagɨm gu Seres gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Si gu kai' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan kua'da' gu chuukug cham gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' va'k gu bhóogɨt gu ux tɨɨda' vupui bhaan.
Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' mi'p a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt na ba' bhaan jix ai gu Amaan gu takarui' gu Ester ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu Amaan i'i bɨɨx gu suudai' gu Ester.

Ba' jix aa' gio gook gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' gu Ester gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va; gio ba' gu Kuaal gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai' gu Ester tu' gu chuukug gu Kuaal gu oi'ñga'n gu ux ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt gu ux tu duukam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Ester; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' ka't gu jodai' gu oidha' gu ux gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ux gu oi'ñga'n.

Na gu' na gu' gu jodai' dhi' tu' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu suudai' na ba' gu suudai' koko'kam gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu' na ba' tu duukam gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu takarui' xoi'kam bhaamki'ñdha' cham jugi gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu Ester; gio ba' gu Kuieen duukat gu bhóogɨt tu' gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Ester; gio ba' bhaamki'ñdha' gu tasi' dhi' gu chuukug gu Amaan; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Amaan vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' suudai' u'va i'iich ka't u'uu pai' gu vaak; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Amaan na ba' gu suudai' gu Ester gu ux gu oidha'; na gu' jix ñi' ka't gu suudai' na ba' cham bhai' baasɨ'n gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' u'uu pai' gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' suudai' u'va gu Amaan ka't gu vaak bhaan dhim ka't gu Ester; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gio na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' kua' gu chuukug gu vaak na ja'p dhi' gu ñi'ook jix buus gu chin gu gɨ'kora' gu vupui gu Amaan ka't jix bhaan dhaas.

Ba' jix aa' gu arbona maa'n gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu suudai' gio gu takarui' mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' jix duu gu Amaan na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't tu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu ux gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Amaan; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; jano' ba' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Amaan gu takarui' ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu Ester gu vaak gu Amaan bhaamki'ñdha' tɨtda:―¿Aapi'; na gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim suudai' u'va vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' na gu' gu Ester gu ñi'ook ka't gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug ka't gu bhóogɨt jix bhɨɨ gu Amaan jix maa gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gu Ester jix dhaas gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu vaak gu Amaan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Ester ñiokda' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' mi'x juu'ñ tɨɨt joi'ndam gu takarui' gu jodai' gu suudai' tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Amaan gu Agageo gu kutun ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan tɨtda:―¿Aapi'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ester gu i'ii'ñ jix uam jodai gu Ester jix búup jix dhaas tɨɨt vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' jix bhai'x tu' gu vupui ka't ua'nak na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu kutun gu Amaan gu mar gu Amadata gu Agageo ua'na na ba' cham tu' duu tɨtda:―¿Aapi' bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham bhai' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chajaañ gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu Ester gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu suudai' tu' jix maa gu Ester gu vaak gu Amaan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' na gu' jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan tɨtda:―¿Aapi'.

Jano' ba' gu o'o gu takarui' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' na ja'p xoi'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu'p ua'ñxidha' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' cham na ba' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu mɨmɨim gu o'o gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' vaik gu Sibaan gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' ua'na jurtu'nka' bɨx jix aa'ñdhix gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨtda:―¿Aapi' gu ñi'ook chiñia' oidha' gɨ' ka't dɨr gu India bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' chamaam gu oi'ñga'n oidha' gɨ'; mi' dhɨr pai' gɨ' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jurtu'nka' nɨɨn tɨtda:―¿Aapi' gio jurtu'nka' gu'p nɨɨn.
Jano' ba' ua'na gu tɨɨgɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' bhañ gu bhóogɨt gu ux jix duñia' kavaayo gɨ' kavɨk gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' gu tanoolh tɨtda:―¿Aapi' mi'p bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu suudai' cham tu' duu kooda' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ja'tkam oidha' gɨ' gu suudai' bhaan gu suudai' a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu takarui' na ba' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Adar.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu'p ka't jix maa gu ux jir bɨx bhai' oidha' gɨ' na ba' jum duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam chɨtda tɨtda:―¿Aapi' gu suudai' na ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ba' gu suudai' obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' moor gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga ka't gu jodai' gu Susaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix buus gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx tɨi'chu' vaak ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt jix toja kuruun jix uam jodai gu ux gu tasi' ñakaabma'; gio ba' kiicham gu Susaan jix duñia' jix suudai' duu.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' chooto'n gu tasi' gu kutun gu bhóogɨt nɨidhat.

Jano' ba' oidha' gɨ' kiicham pai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' chooto'n gu kutun gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook; na gu' mui'x gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tɨtda:―¿Aapi' na gu' choo'n tɨtda:―¿Aapi' ka't gu vaak bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Adar gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tanoolh jix duñia' obhɨɨ'ñ tɨtda:―¿Aapi' gu ñi'ook ka't gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' jum daa'ñ jɨ'dɨlh bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ bhaan gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt cham bhai'; na gu' soo'mchulhdhak jix dhaas vupui bhaan na gu' choo'n ka't gu vaak bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx chiñia' oidha' gɨ' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' tɨtda:―¿Aapi'; na gu' choo'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't gu vaak bhaan.

Na gu' na gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't jix gɨ' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu ux bɨx oidha' gɨ'; na gu' gu chio'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu ux gu kuchii jix koi jai'chdhɨlhia'; gio ba' jix duu obhɨɨ'ñ aagak.
Jano' ba' gu Susaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' mu'aa gu chuukug tɨtda:―¿Aapi' gu takarui' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Dalpoon gu Aspata.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Aridata.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Arisai gu Aridai gu Baisata.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Amaan gu mar gu Amadata bhaamki'ñdha' tɨtda:―¿Aapi'; gu' gu ja'tkam cham jix duñia' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh suudai' u'va jix duñia' koko'kam gu Susaan gu suudai' jix suudai' duu vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' gu Ester; gio ba' gu Susaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix duñia' jix koi tɨtda:―¿Aapi' gu jodai' gu takarui' gu chichio'ñ mambhɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Amaan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu ñi'ook oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu Kuaal gu i'ii'ñ tu' ka't gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Ester; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gio gu xibh tɨtda:―¿Aapi' gu Susaan xoi'kam jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu takarui' mambhɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Amaan.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai'; gio ba' jix maa gu vaak gu Susaan jix duñia' mambhɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Amaan.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' mi'p gu Susaan jum daa'ñ gio gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Adar mu'aa gu Susaan vaik gu chichio'ñ; gu' gu ja'tkam cham jix duñia' gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' mi'p oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gio jum daa'ñ jix dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' chooto'n jɨɨpi'ñka' obhɨɨ'ñ mu'aa gu jodai' gu vaak jixchamaam jix bhai'x; gu' gu ja'tkam cham jix duñia' gu novɨ.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh gu suudai' gu takarui' gu Adar ka't dhi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jix duu gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu kutun.
Gu' gu' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' mi'p gu Susaan jum daa'ñ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix duu mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu takarui' jix suudai' duu.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n cham vaak jodai xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Adar gu tanoolh gu kutun gu takarui' jix bhai' gu tanoolh tɨip gu jodai' maa'n gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ua'na gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim dhi' tu'x bhañ gu bhóogɨt bɨx tɨtda:―¿Aapi' mi'p bɨx oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' mia'n gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu chuukug gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu Adar gu ñi'ook oi'ñga'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tanoolh tɨtda:―¿Aapi' chooto'n jɨɨpi'ñka' obhɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu ñi'ook ɨlhdha' gu kutun gu chuukug gu tanoolh jix bhai'; na gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt tɨip gu jodai' maa'n gu chuukug gu suudai' bia'.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' jix duñia' duñia' bhaan gu suudai' kua'da' ua'na gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Na gu' na gu' gu Amaan gu mar gu Amadata gu Agageo bhaamki'ñdha' bɨx tɨtda:―¿Aapi' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan tɨtda:―¿Aapi' na ba' cham tu' duu mi'x juu'ñ gu Pur gu suudai' gu chuukug gu maa'nkar na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.

Gu' gu' na ja'p gu chuukug suudai' u'va gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhai'x gu kutun gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan tɨtda:―¿Aapi' gu chuukug bhaan mo'o; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' tɨɨt dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Purim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Pur; gio ba' gu ux bɨx gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ux jix duñia' bhaan dhi' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix bhɨɨ tɨtda:―¿Aapi' bhaan gu kai' bhaan bɨx gu jodai' cham ka't bhaan gu takarui' dhi' ja'tkam gook gu tanoolh bhaan ua'nak gu vaak jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook oi'ñga'.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gook gu tanoolh jix duu chɨ'ñchoka' gu jodai' bɨx gu ja'tkam ja'tkam vaak oidha' gɨ' jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Purim cham gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨtda:―¿Aapi' chɨ'ñchoka' cham jix duñia' gu kai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Ester mar u'vɨ gu Abiail gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gookim gu ñi'ook gu Purim.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu bhóogɨt bɨx tɨtda:―¿Aapi' chamaam gu oi'ñga'n oidha' gɨ' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'r.

Na ba' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Purim gu bhóogɨt miil bhaan ka't gu chuukug gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Ester na ja'p gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ bhaan gu kai' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Ester jix duñia' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Purim ua'na u'uan.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu takarui' namki'ñdha' bhaan gu oidha' gu chuukug gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai' gu tasi' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' cham ua'nak u'uan gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Media gu Persia.

Na gu' na gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook ka't gook mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' jix gɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨtda:―¿Aapi' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam gu suudai' xoi'kam gu ja'tkam a'gi'ñchu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ba' bɨx gu kai'.
